newsitem.title: POLAND: POLE KILLED BY OWN ANTI-BURGLAR BOOBY TRAP.
newsitem.headline: POLE KILLED BY OWN ANTI-BURGLAR BOOBY TRAP.

text.p: A Pole who filled his house with deadly booby traps against burglars fell victim to his own precautions, Warsaw police said on Wednesday.
Spokesman Andrzej Przemyski said 60-year-old Czeslaw B, was found shot dead on Tuesday by the half-open doors of his garage in Kosianka Trojanowka village, eastern Poland.
"It emerged from initial inspection that the fatal shots came from two booby trap home-made guns mounted on the garage doors," Przemyski said in a statement issued to reporters.
Police at the scene called in specialised explosives experts who, moving cautiously through the house, found eight similar traps by the front door, in rooms and in the attic.
Each device was fitted with a discreet off-switch.
"The police explosives experts said later they felt as if they were crossing a minefield," Przemyski added.
"They knew that each door they opened, any object they touched, could set off a fatal shot."
The search revealed 28 more such gadgets in the house, in various stages of construction.
"Everything unambiguously suggests that Czeslaw B. wanted to safeguard his house against burglars and so prepared his own death," Przemyski said.
By custom, Polish police do not reveal the full surname of people involved in investigations. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
